status: DESIGN_FROZEN_BEFORE_MODEL_RUN; calendar boundaries require audited target data
objective: Estimate the incremental out-of-time predictive value of news conditional on historical numerical information. This is not a causal effect estimate or a guarantee of present-day performance.

target_proposal.population: Seoul district by food-service industry, subject to data availability audit
target_proposal.outcome: Next-quarter change in the documented estimated-sales measure

models.B1: Numerical history, calendar and known covariates only
models.B2: Same base family and numeric inputs plus past news features
models.B3: Numeric base plus news-volume features only, isolating semantic contribution
models.B4: Numeric base plus deliberately stale news sampled only from information available before each origin; fixed random seeds

feature_policy: Use only records genuinely available by each forecast timestamp, not just events dated earlier.
Retain publication time, event time, historical snapshot hash, source URL and statistic release/vintage.
Deduplicate syndicated stories into events; do not select event types using final holdout outcomes.
Use fold-local vocabulary, imputation, scaling and feature selection. Start with transparent text features fitted from past data.
Treat current pretrained model knowledge and retrospective LLM summaries as contamination risks; document training cutoff or obtain prospective evidence.
Never use generated preds fields as observed labels or silently as ex-ante forecasts.
Provide both arms the same numeric covariates and tuning budget; record model capacity and costs.
temporal_design: Development period: expanding-origin validation. A training label may enter only after its own release timestamp.
Separate earlier development origins and later confirmation origins; reserve the latest untouched block for one final evaluation.
Purge training targets extending past an origin and embargo overlapping horizons when necessary.
Freeze model, features, thresholds and splits before opening final holdout results. No result-driven stopping or selecting only winning periods.
Report each period, industry and market regime, including adverse results; shared district dates are not independent time samples.

measurement.primary: Paired out-of-time MAE difference B1 minus B2; report relative improvement as well
measurement.probability_claim_gate: If event probabilities are emitted, compare Brier score with historical-frequency and numeric-only baselines and inspect reliability; do not interpret MAE gains as calibrated probabilities.
measurement.uncertainty: Paired moving-block bootstrap by forecast origin, preserving same-date cross-sectional dependence. Freeze block length using development data and document sensitivity.
measurement.multiple_comparisons: Declare one primary comparison and endpoint. Adjust confirmatory multiple tests; label post-hoc subgroup results exploratory.
measurement.sample_size: Assess effective forecast-origin count and power before claiming significance. A large row count across districts does not replace a sufficient history.

candidate_pass_gates: Historical availability and provenance audit passes for all included features and labels.

The primary comparison improves MAE by at least a proposed 5% practical threshold on the untouched holdout, with a 95% paired block-bootstrap interval for improvement above zero. The 5% threshold is a design choice, not a universal standard.
The earlier and later confirmation periods do not show a material reversal; latest-regime and pooled results are reported together.
B2 beats seasonal naive and news-volume/stale-news controls; interpret any failure explicitly rather than relabeling it as semantic news value.
Probability or warning claims separately pass calibration and user-relevant false-alarm checks.
Before operational warning use, freeze and timestamp prospective forecasts and evaluate once sufficient new outcomes arrive.

claim_levels.literature: Feasibility evidence from other tasks only
claim_levels.retrospective_target_pass: Evidence of historical incremental predictive value on this target under this protocol
claim_levels.prospective_target_pass: Conditional evidence of present-domain usefulness, subject to continued drift monitoring
claim_levels.never_claim: Past success logically proves all current or future news-based predictions are valid
